subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language,'TREE' is written as WWHJ, and 'LEAF' is written as OJDK. How will 'BARK' be written in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 The alphabets at the odd place are increased to 3 positional values.

 **The alphabets at the even place are increased to 5 positional values.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82abb6293631471bbb2c2c3352049d1c940b7d9330e3fdf5c5516a5f69ba4d4f.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0669a4a5398bfd521fc11017ed8f0c1cf8964a7921eb3015cc195c944e25857e.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42e3228114f5164c764be9fdd282d9adab3829e8ad9299352a7b2c0652312c9e.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 4)**
